lines.zh: 我一步一步逼近，手臂拖在身侧。
lines.en: I advance step by step, arms dragging at my sides.

lines.zh: 我身上的源石在发红光。
lines.en: The originium on my body glows red.

lines.zh: 我朝你走过的方向压过去。
lines.en: I press along the way you went.
My steps have no rhythm, only weight.
I go around the slag heap and come straight on.

lines.zh: 我一动，甲片互相摩着响。
lines.en: When I move, my plates grind together.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，可你跑不远。
lines.en: I walk slowly, and you will not get far.
I smash the blocking crystals aside.

lines.zh: 我在你身后几步跟着走。
lines.en: I keep a few steps behind you.
I head for wherever the heat is.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条手臂，蹭着地面。
lines.en: I drag one arm along the ground.
I walk crookedly forward.

lines.zh: 我站着，胸口起伏得很重。
lines.en: I stand, my chest heaving heavily.

lines.zh: 我的头低着，眼睛往上翻。
lines.en: My head is low, my eyes rolled up.

lines.zh: 我在等源石给我更多力气。
lines.en: I wait for the originium to give me more strength.
My fingers twitch.

lines.zh: 我身上发出细微的裂声。
lines.en: Small cracking sounds come from me.
I bend my neck to one side.
Ore dust rides on my breath.
I am counting how many steps away you are.
I close my fist slowly.
My stillness is worse than my motion.
Originium swells the host larger.
You carry iron, and blood too.
I raise my eyes slowly.

lines.zh: 我手臂拖在身侧，源石在发红。
lines.en: My arms drag at my sides, the originium glowing red.
My body is harder than you think.
Each step you retreat, my red light grows brighter.
There are many teeth in my mouth.

lines.zh: 你站的地方不错，我看到了。
lines.en: You have found a decent spot; I saw.
You dare look at me like this.
Your armour will not stop originium.
I step back and my red glow dims.

lines.zh: 你打中我，我低头看了看。
lines.en: You hit me and I look down at it.
A piece of crystal breaks off me.
I hiss and show my teeth.
A corner of the crystal on my shoulder breaks.
I press the wound and keep walking.
The blow knocks my shoulder crooked.
I shudder and ore dust falls.
You are stronger than the usual resistor.
I raise my head, my eyes brighter.
I want the iron on you.
Raise your weapon; good.
The farther you back off, the more the originium pushes me.
Call out whoever stands behind you.
That small light, I hate it.
You are by the vein; perfect.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell what is in your hand.
Do not think of climbing out.
Hiding in the cave suits me better.
You are shaking; I know.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，你退了很重的一步。
lines.en: I hit you and you stagger back a heavy step.
My shoulder drives into your chest.
My hand closes on your shoulder strap.

lines.zh: 相撞时，我身上的晶响起来。
lines.en: At the impact, the crystals on me ring.
You knock me half a step off line.
I catch your arm with one hand.

lines.zh: 我们撞开时，地面碎了一角。
lines.en: When we break apart, a corner of ground breaks.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，手都麻了。
lines.en: You hit me and your hand goes numb.

lines.zh: 我退开，是给自己留距离。
lines.en: I pull back to make room.
You are pressed down and cannot rise.
I only want something to hit.
My body is all originium.
I do not listen to such talk.
A host's body knows nothing of this.
I raise a hand and you step back.
I shake my head slowly.
I know only orders and blood.
That has nothing to do with me.

lines.zh: 宿主的胳膊，被源石撑大。
lines.en: Originium has swollen this host's arms.
You had better start running now.
The iron bends into a lump in my fist.
I pick it up and push it into my mouth.
This iron is mine.

lines.zh: 我用一只手把它拎起来。
lines.en: I lift it with one hand.
I hold it and smash it into the ground.
I pick up the weapon and weigh it.
Your thing; I have it.
This is too small to be useful.
I throw it far away.
I pick it up, look, and drop it.
Berserk, I don't know the way back.

lines.zh: 你是这附近唯一活着的。
lines.en: You are the only living thing nearby.
I drag one leg toward you.
The target is this one who will not move.
I raise my originium arm past my shoulder.
The originium has marked you.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在我耳里放大
lines.en: Your footsteps grow loud in my ears.
I decide how this goes.
My forefoot gouges a trench in the ground.

lines.zh: 你血里的铁味，我闻到了
lines.en: I smell the iron in your blood.
I am not choosy; anyone will do.
You have entered my range.
I tilt my head toward you.
What follows is pursuit.

lines.zh: 晶体从我的指节顶出来
lines.en: Crystals push out through my knuckles.
Red light shines through my back.
Step by step, flattening the road.
You run; I do not need to.

lines.zh: 狂暴宿主的组长，喊一声就冲。
lines.en: The host squad leader shouts once, then charges.
I step right over that boulder.

lines.zh: 我身上的红光越来越亮。
lines.en: The red glow on me brightens.

lines.zh: 狂暴的时候，我认不出人。
lines.en: When I go berserk, I can't tell people apart.
I can hear your footsteps.
My fingers keep twitching.
I close in one heavy step at a time.
The back of your neck is right before me.
Drop your things; I will not stop.
These crystals of mine are harder than armour.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸压着你的节奏
lines.en: My breathing weighs down your rhythm.

lines.zh: 我挡在你唯一的出口前。
lines.en: I stand before your only way out.
You are within a few steps of me.
I need no voice; you know.
I'm right at your heels.

lines.zh: 你听见的呼吸声是我的。
lines.en: The breathing you hear is mine.
I lower my hands slowly.
After this step, close enough.
My fist comes down and the ground splits.
My claws rake your chest.
That blow knocks you away.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的肩膀，很用力。
lines.en: I seize your shoulder, hard.
My arm sweeps across.
You blocked and still fell back.

lines.zh: 这一下带着矿石的碎屑。
lines.en: That blow came with ore fragments.

lines.zh: 宿主一狂暴，就没人拦得住。
lines.en: Once a host rages, no one stops it.
You are left gasping.
I raise my hand and bring it down again.
One punch dents your breastplate.
I grin and bare a full row of teeth.
You pull back, and I follow slowly.
My fist is heavier than iron.
I held nothing back.
As you fall, I am still walking.

lines.zh: 我喘着气，红光亮了一下。
lines.en: Breathing hard, my red glow flares.
This will make you remember me.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领往上提，宿主在吼。
lines.en: I lift you by the collar; the host roars.
You hit back, and I am still standing.

lines.zh: 矿脉那边传来一声闷响。
lines.en: A dull crack comes from the vein.
I rise out of the heap of stones.
The red glow on me lights up.

lines.zh: 你先听到甲片摩的声音。
lines.en: You hear plates grinding first.

lines.zh: 我一步一步从洞里走出来。
lines.en: I walk out of the cave step by step.

lines.zh: 源石在我身上长了很久。
lines.en: The originium has grown on me a long time.

lines.zh: 甲片摩擦的声音，你该听见了。
lines.en: You should have heard the plates grinding.
I raise my head out of the dark.
My breathing comes before me.

lines.zh: 这里多了一个不该有的东西。
lines.en: Something has appeared here that should not be.
I push up from under the slag.
I straighten, taller than you expected.

lines.zh: 火烧上来，我的皮肤皱起。
lines.en: Fire rises and my skin puckers.

lines.zh: 落地时我的手臂撑裂了地
lines.en: My arm cracks the ground as I land.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我咳得发抖。
lines.en: Water floods my throat and I cough, shaking.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，矿渣满天。
lines.en: The blast flips me and slag fills the air.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我肩上，我拔出来折断。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my shoulder; I pull it out and snap it.

lines.zh: 法术压过来，我的红光被盖住。
lines.en: Magic presses in and my red glow is smothered.

lines.zh: 没有源石可吃，我在枯萎。
lines.en: With no originium to feed on, I am withering.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我身上的晶炸开。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and crystals burst on my body.

lines.zh: 虚空拽我下去，我抓着矿壁。
lines.en: The void hauls me down and I claw at the ore wall.
